status_semantics.implemented_partial: native code and deterministic wire-shaped evidence exist; the capability group still lacks one or more required lifecycle or platform proofs
status_semantics.blocked_unsupported: adapter rejects before transport until an approved endpoint fixture exists
status_semantics.verified: the listed narrow capability evidence has a fixture, exact request/response or Fabric result, and the required lifecycle assertion
